summary: G-LOAD(2000) passes the §2.1 budget on this 20-core Mac: 2000/2000 tasks, idle RSS p99 5.78 MiB (11 GB total), idle 0.35 cores, all-waiting 0.22 cores, idle wakeups p99 1.7/s, threads 3/4, fds 5, per-round overhead p99 49.9 ms. The harness found that F_FULLFSYNC (macOS sync_data/sync_all) serialized every agent; journal, WAL, tool output and writes now use POSIX fsync.
commands_run: cargo test --locked --all-features --no-fail-fast --lib --test tools --test stage1_tool_output --test run_command_pi --test session_fsync --test session_recovery --test session_torn_tail --test headless_wal --test tasks --test tasks_headless --test tools_edit_paths
notes: Master revised two §2.1 rows to the accepted ZE-303/304 designs (fsync <= 3 per tool call; WAL bytes reported, events buffered). Tasks are ramped over N/200 s; a lockstep start (--ramp 0) degrades on this shared Mac (XProtect scans every fresh exec, other workloads running) and is not a gate. The machine is a shared 20-core dev Mac, not a dedicated 16-core box.
